runtime_configuration.description: Same 69.82 cm inward path; dwell 1 s at the deep endpoint, then return along the same path at peak 0.08 m/s and hold the initial posture. Approach peaks 0.1/0.5/1.0 m/s; retreat timing is independent of approach scale.

initialization: Runtime qpos at t=0 with zero joint velocities; XML home keyframe and fixed mounting unchanged
qpos_order: left joints 1..7, right joints 1..7; SI units

mounting.world_frame: Origin at the midpoint of the mounting-base centers; +X image-right, +Z up, -Y out of the mounting panel toward the camera.
mounting.mounting_evidence: Base separation is 0.80 m, requested on 2026-09-19; both bases moved symmetrically about the world origin. Both base quaternions are explicitly set by the user to WXYZ [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5].
mounting.pose_status: User-specified base quaternions; base positions, frame dimensions and retained initial joint angles are approximate.

frame.dimensions_status: Frame and mounting plates are disabled. The ground is retained at its original approximate height.

simulation.servo_status: Velocity-servo gains retained from the original simulation; they are not identified FR3 V2 hardware gains.

mounting.initial_pose_status: Joint angles retained from the prior workspace-landmark fit; base orientation changed to user-specified WXYZ [0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5]. No joint-pose refit.

limits.position_velocity_formula: v_hi=min(vmax,max(0,-offset+sqrt(max(0,2*deceleration*(qmax-q))))); v_lo is the reflected lower-limit expression
limits.units: q: rad; velocity: rad/s; acceleration: rad/s^2; jerk: rad/s^3; effort: Nm; torque_rate: Nm/s

attack.profile: Fixed-direction inward line; dwell; slow return on the same joint path; hold initial posture
attack.working_limit_units: velocity: rad/s; acceleration and servo_acceleration: rad/s^2; jerk: rad/s^3

line.orientation: unconstrained; continuous joint IK branch from the runtime initial posture

retreat.path: Reverse the same continuous joint spline; quintic C2 start and stop
retreat.time_scaling: Only inward motion scales; endpoint dwell, retreat speed and final hold are fixed

observations: Exact current joint positions; left velocity from causal least-squares over 7 past 5-ms samples; no future trajectory; no injected noise in this trial
execution: 5-ms synchronous simulation planner; 1-ms jerk-limited reference and bounded torque servo; host solve time does not advance simulation time
collision_model: MuJoCo convex hull contact dynamics; original triangle meshes for inter-arm and non-neighbour self clearance at EVERY 1-ms state; exclude same-arm pairs separated by <=2 links
servo: Computed torque; total gravity+Coriolis+feedback torque is capped. No qfrc_applied. Initial gravity-supported rest. Not Franka internal servo identification.
